alloy.preparation: Specimens 7 × 10 × 1 mm sealed in a pre-evacuated quartz tube, annealed at 1100°C for 3 h, and water-quenched by breaking the tube under water. Mechanically polished from 600 grit to a 0.25-µm diamond finish.

test_solution.preparation: Table 2 calls the solution aerated. Experimental methods specify argon purging for 2 h and execution in an argon-purged glove box; Figure 1 calls it de-aerated.

test_method.procedure_description: Conventional Green cell with saturated calomel reference. Cathodically polarized at −1.150 V (SCE) for 15 min to reduce the polishing film, then swept in the anodic direction at 1 mV/s. Cathodic branch uses 0.3 M NaCl at pH 5.4; pH adjustment for the alkaline scan occurs at open circuit. Separate −0.180 V passive-film/XPS holds are not assigned as pretreatment to the pitting scans.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Epit identified in the anodic-polarization curve and tabulated in Table 2; no numerical current threshold is specified.

experiments.result_note: Table 2 caption says aerated; the experimental method and Figure 1 caption say de-aerated. Retained without resolving that source conflict. The electrode reference is explicitly SCE in the methods. Carbon, nitrogen and sulfur composition limits are strict < values, represented as upper bounds. No numerical electrolyte temperature is given for these pitting scans; the 70°C film-analysis experiment is a separate condition. NaOH adjustment stock concentration is not the final NaOH concentration.
